item.title: Compute brief - 14 October 2026
item.description: Power and leases converted on Wednesday while prices sat still. AEP plans about $4 billion for a 702 MW Bloom Energy fuel cell plant near Cheyenne, Wyoming, selling to Google under a 20-year PPA, with construction starting in 2026 and full operation by the end of 2028. Fermi filed a fact sheet calling its TensorWave phase one lease at Project Matador, Texas binding: 15 years, $6.5 billion of contracted revenue, 222 MW total and 156 MW critical IT, delivery from Q4 2027, with AMD credit support signed a day earlier. Mason County, Kentucky approved a community benefits agreement naming Meta as developer of a hyperscale campus on more than 2,000 zoned acres. Upstream, ASML reported record Q3 sales of EUR 11.7 billion and said its planned supply for 2027 and 2028 will not fully meet customer demand. On the public silicon tape every venue returned HTTP 200 and every print held: 69 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW. Countries: United States / Wyoming: AEP about $4 billion, 702 MW Bloom fuel cells near Cheyenne under a 20-year Google PPA; construction 2026, full operation by end 2028 (Wire, 14 Oct). United States / Texas: Fermi x TensorWave binding 15-year lease at Matador: $6.5 billion, 222 MW total / 156 MW critical IT, delivery Q4 2027 to early 2028; AMD credit support; financing not yet closed (Wire, 14 Oct). United States / Kentucky: Mason County Fiscal Court approves Meta hyperscale CBA; 2,000-plus acres zoned; $10 billion (CBA) to $15 billion (county attorney) initial investment reported; no MW disclosed (Wire, 13 Oct). India: CtrlS LOI with Bihar for a Rs 10,000 crore (about $1.05 billion) 150 MW AI factory in Bodh Gaya; Patna 12 MW opened. IndiaAI RFE for up to 10,000 compute units. Adani x Jabil rack JV MoU (non-binding). Signal only. Japan: Nikkei via Reuters: NTT Data in final talks to build Anthropic's first Japan data center in Osaka, up to 500 MW and up to JPY 1 trillion, partial operation as early as 2028. Talks only (Signal).
